'''Vala''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Vala traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dalicron-4]], and became an assistant to the beverage maker [[Jem]].<ref name="Child of Light" />
